Health Partners of Western Ohio takes seriously its responsibility to use 340B savings to benefit patients and strengthen access to care in the communities we serve. These savings help bridge medication access gaps for uninsured patients, underinsured patients, and patients facing financial hardship.

As a safety net provider, HPWO also uses 340B savings to expand the range and reach of services available to our patients. Since opening our first pharmacy in 2006, HPWO has grown to include 25 additional sites, including locations in both urban and rural communities, 8 pharmacies, and 13 school-based health centers, and 8 dental operatories. All of which include behavioral health and substance abuse services . HPWO is also currently working on 4 separate building projects that will expand access to these services for even more patients.

Within our pharmacies, 340B savings have helped support adherence packaging services for patients across all 9 of our community health centers. More than 200 patients now receive this additional level of pharmacy support, which would not be possible at the same scale without 340B savings. HPWO plans to expand this service to eventually reach 1,000 patients.

340B savings also allow HPWO to offer free medication delivery 5 days per week at all pharmacy locations. This service is especially important as many of our communities have become pharmacy deserts due to widespread retail-chain pharmacy closures.

Overall, 340B savings allow HPWO to continue growing, serving more patients, expanding needed services, and improving the quality of care we provide. Most importantly, these savings help ensure that individual patients can access needed medications without financial barriers.
